intent: Reserve a box at a fixed width-to-height ratio so the layout around it does not shift when its content loads.
typical_uses: Holding space for an image, video or embed before it loads, so surrounding layout does not jump
Tiles in a grid or gallery that must share one proportion regardless of each item's natural size

dont_use_when.situation: Content with a natural, already-fixed size (a fixed-size icon or badge)

instead.note: A ratio box buys nothing for content that does not stretch to fill it - render the content directly. The kit ships no component for this case beyond the plain element the host page already provides.

invariants.text: A consumer's `style` is spread after the component's own inline `--ratio`, so a `--ratio` key inside a consumer style silently overrides the `ratio` prop.

anti_patterns.dont: Expect the box to crop or scale the child to fit
anti_patterns.do_instead: Size the child to the box yourself (a full-size img with `object-fit: cover`, for example); the box reserves proportions only

good.title: Holding space for a photo before it loads
Square tiles that share one proportion

bad.title: Expecting the box to crop the child
bad.why: Without sizing of its own the child does not fill the box, so the reserved space shows through and an oversized image spills out.

bad.title: Ratio smuggled through a style key
bad.why: The style key wins over the `ratio` prop, so the box renders 1:1.
